context: This criteria evaluates whether the solution correctly uses the request package's JSON capabilities to automatically serialize request bodies and parse response bodies without manual JSON.stringify() or JSON.parse() calls.

checklist.name: JSON option usage
checklist.description: Uses the json option set to true or an object to enable automatic JSON handling

checklist.name: POST with JSON body
checklist.description: Correctly sends POST requests with json option containing the payload object

checklist.name: Automatic parsing
checklist.description: Leverages automatic JSON response parsing without manual JSON.parse() calls

checklist.name: Content-Type header
checklist.description: Relies on automatic Content-Type: application/json header setting via json option

checklist.name: PUT/POST methods
checklist.description: Uses appropriate HTTP methods (request.post(), request.put()) with JSON payloads
